StepSequence.holds is StepSequence.steps, and stepSequence's parameter and
errors say step. Kept as English: sample-and-hold (the signal term the API
is named for) and the pulse's beat.

Visual rows are taken off the render, and a test holds them to it (rich-unfiled-791c.pe16) (#550)

* Visual rows are taken off the render, and a test holds them to it (rich-unfiled-791c.pe16)

A visual row is ordered by levels resolved over its whole line, so wrap keeps
refusing it. Segment.splitLines of the render is each placed row; the test
pins that drawn one per line they equal the render in bytes, HTML and SVG,
including the RTL hanging-whitespace and neutral/number-at-a-break cases.
